scope: Lagging aggregate across candidate and verification activity; not exact measurement-window billing.

queries.query:
INSERT INTO transaction_checks(valid) SELECT CASE WHEN (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM calendars c WHERE c.id = ? AND c.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.sub = ? AND u.disabled = 0)
  AND ((c.team_id IS NULL AND c.owner_sub = ?) OR
    (c.team_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t JOIN memberships m ON m.team_id = t.id
      WHERE t.id = c.team_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND m.user_sub = ?))) AND (c.team_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships m
  WHERE m.team_id = c.team_id AND m.user_sub = ? AND
    (m.role IN ('owner', 'manager') OR (m.role = 'member' AND c.assigned_sub = ?)))))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT disabled FROM users WHERE sub = ?
INSERT INTO transaction_checks(valid) SELECT CASE WHEN (COALESCE((SELECT version FROM calendar_days WHERE calendar_id = ? AND date = ?), 0) = ?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

SELECT c.* FROM calendars c WHERE c.id = ? AND c.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.sub = ? AND u.disabled = 0)

INSERT INTO calendar_days(calendar_id,date,shift_code,version,deleted,updated_at,updated_by)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(calendar_id,date) DO UPDATE SET shift_code=excluded.shift_code,
          version=excluded.version,deleted=excluded.deleted,updated_at=excluded.updated_at,updated_by=excluded.updated_by
SELECT * FROM calendar_days WHERE calendar_id = ? AND date BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY date LIMIT ?

SELECT c.* FROM calendars c WHERE c.owner_sub = ?

    (c.team_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t JOIN memberships m ON m.team_id = t.id
      WHERE t.id = c.team_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND m.user_sub = ?))) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT ?
